subject.title: fix(ollama): resolve web search secret refs

question: Should Ollama web search treat an unavailable explicitly configured SecretRef as authoritative over ambient OLLAMA_API_KEY fallback and expose provider normalization/error hooks through the shared plugin SDK resolver?
rationale: The implementation correctly enforces the proposed policy, but tests cannot decide whether this compatibility change and public SDK expansion are the intended permanent contract.

options.title: Approve shared fail-closed policy
options.body: Accept explicit unavailable Ollama refs as authoritative, approve the additive SDK hooks, and regenerate the final baseline before merge.

options.title: Preserve ambient fallback
options.body: Keep shared SecretRef resolution but allow ambient OLLAMA_API_KEY when the configured ref cannot resolve.

options.title: Avoid SDK hook expansion
options.body: Keep provider-specific behavior behind a narrower Ollama-owned seam instead of expanding the exported shared helper.

recommendation.title: Approve shared fail-closed policy
recommendation.body: Accept explicit unavailable Ollama refs as authoritative, approve the additive SDK hooks, and regenerate the final baseline before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the current shared helper and Ollama credential behavior in the immediately preceding merged feature change.
